related_questions.question: Is Barclays a good investment bank?

text_blocks.snippet: Barclays is generally considered a good investment bank, particularly within the "bulge bracket" category, but it's not always at the top of the list. It has a long history, strong global presence, and a wide range of services, including a well-regarded investment banking division. However, some reports suggest its investment bank might not consistently perform at the same level as its competitors in certain areas.

list.title: Investment bank performance:
